author: Stejneger, 1884
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록
habitat: 섬과 바닷가 벼랑, 해안 암초, 방파제, 모래밭, 풀밭(둥지 자리)
summary: 국내에서는 흔하지 않은 겨울새로, 우리나라와 중국, 일본 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 무리를 지어 먹이를 찾으며 개·고양이·새의 사체, 오리류와 바닷새의 알, 죽은 물고기를 먹고 갑각류, 연체동물, 환형동물, 곤충도 먹는다. 번식지에서는 섬이나 바닷가의 벼랑, 암초, 호숫가 땅, 방파제, 모래밭, 풀밭 등에 무리 지어 둥지를 틀고 5월 하순~7월에 알 3~4개를 낳는다. 북태평양 서부, 오호츠크해 연안, 캄차카, 사할린 등지에 분포한다.

points.en: white tips to the outer primaries

young: 어린새는 윗면이 연한 갈색에 거무스름한 세로무늬가 있고 아랫면은 회색, 턱밑은 흰색이다. 꽁지는 갈색에 끝이 희며, 기부에 짙은 갈색 대리석 무늬가 있다.

similar.how: 거의 비슷하지만 윗등이 어두운 석판색이라 쉽게 구별된다.

art.subject: Slaty-backed Gull (Larus schistisagus), adult in winter as seen on Korean coasts from November to March: head and neck white, heavily streaked and smudged grey-brown, densest around the eye and on the hindneck; mantle and folded wings dark slate-grey; a broad white band of tertial and secondary tips (a white 'skirt') along the folded wing; primaries black with white tips; underparts and tail white. Bill heavy, yellow, with a red spot on the lower mandible; pale yellow iris with a pinkish-red orbital ring; legs deep bright pink.
art.pose: standing among a loose flock on the shore, side view
art.scene: Korean seashore in winter: rocky reef and sandy beach beside a grey open sea; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing: dark slate-grey back and wings, broad white skirt along the folded wing, black wingtips with white tips, grey-brown smudged and streaked head, heavy yellow bill with a red spot, bright pink legs
adult in flight seen from above: dark slate-grey wings with a very broad white trailing edge, black outer primaries crossed by a row of white spots and tipped white
adult in flight seen from below: white body and underwing coverts contrasting with a dark grey band formed by the undersides of the flight feathers

juvenile, side view standing: pale brown upperparts streaked and mottled darker, greyer underparts, whitish chin, plain brown primaries, brown tail with a pale tip and dark marbling at the base, all-dark bill, pink legs
art.build: Large, bulky gull, 61–66cm, about the size of a Vega Gull but more barrel-chested, with a heavy bill, thick neck and relatively short wings: at rest the black wingtips project only moderately beyond the tail. Legs fairly short, deep pink. In flight broad wings, dark slate above, with a very broad white trailing edge and a row of white spots between the slate inner part and the black tips of the outer primaries; from below, white underwing coverts contrast with dark grey flight feathers.
avoid: Do not paint yellow legs; the legs are deep pink (dark-backed gulls with yellow legs are Lesser Black-backed types).
Do not paint a pale silver-grey back like a Vega Gull's, or a black tail band like a Black-tailed Gull's.
Do not omit the broad white trailing edge and the row of white spots across the outer primaries in flight.
Do not paint a dark eye on the adult; its iris is pale yellow.
